about: Tyler L. Farmer, an attorney with Martinez & Farmer LLP in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Business Litigation situations. He also helps clients with General Litigation, Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense and Native American Law concerns.
He received legal training from University of Notre Dame Law School. He graduated from law school in 2000. Tyler Farmer became licensed to practice law in 2000.
Tyler Farmer was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that he is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. He was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026.
